nodes.label: Smart routing
nodes.rationale: Use heuristic request difficulty and model capability to prefer the lowest configured cost tier that can handle the request; ratings are hints, not quality guarantees.

nodes.label: Web dashboard
nodes.rationale: Centralize configuration in the browser so VS Code and the browser do not duplicate configuration screens.

nodes.label: Codex Responses adapter
nodes.rationale: Unofficial subscription-token integration uses automatically refreshed OAuth credentials and an upstream Responses adapter; it is not a client-facing Responses endpoint.

nodes.label: Embedding routing
nodes.rationale: Prefer a stable provider because vectors from different providers can have different dimensions; failover remains possible and cannot guarantee a single dimension.

nodes.label: Automatic model discovery
nodes.rationale: Opt-in because gateways may expose paid models or very large catalogs.

nodes.label: Proxy API keys
nodes.rationale: The same credential tier authorizes inference and configuration writes; budgets and provider scopes do not create non-admin roles.

nodes.label: X-Hermes-Tool-Loop
nodes.rationale: An iterative caller-managed tool loop needs confirmed tool capability and must bypass cached answers.

nodes.label: Estimated usage cost
nodes.rationale: Manually maintained model prices support operational estimates, not invoices; unknown models may appear as zero cost.

nodes.label: Request metadata ring buffer
nodes.rationale: Retain request metadata only in a bounded in-memory ring; response content retention belongs to the response cache.

nodes.label: Free model rankings
nodes.rationale: Repository documentation says last verified July 31, 2026; rankings and provider access are time-sensitive and were not externally revalidated in this graph extraction.

nodes.label: Astro Starlight documentation
nodes.rationale: The source website README is still the Starlight starter template. Routes are backed by Markdown/MDX content files.

nodes.label: Client-owned tool execution
nodes.rationale: Hermes transports inference and tool calls; client applications own filesystem, commands, memory and orchestration.

nodes.label: Shared proxy-key authorization
nodes.rationale: The same proxy keys authorize inference and configuration writes; budgets do not create non-admin roles.

nodes.label: Documented free model rankings
nodes.audit_note: Catalog, price and benchmark claims were not independently checked.

nodes.label: Normalized extension base URL
nodes.rationale: Trailing /v1 is stripped to prevent duplicate /v1/v1/status requests.

nodes.rationale: Version 0.9.0 removed in-editor key, model and rotation configuration in favor of one browser configuration surface.
